resources.string: Enter a key for each service you have. Keys are encrypted on your device and never leave it.
Optional key for more accurate Arabic transcription. Without it the app uses the device engine.
Key saved and encrypted on your device.

Under each reply: chunk count, first-chunk latency, total latency, endpoint, request body and token usage. API keys are always redacted and never shown.
Two or three lines: who you are, and what you usually ask for. Read by the interrogation and the prompt forge only — never sent with a plain chat message, and it never leaves your device.
For example: an English teacher and a father of two. I usually want short practical plans, not academic research.
Every idea you mature and run is saved on this device only — never sent to any server. It stays until you delete it.
Adds a listen button under the answer. The app never speaks on its own — only the button starts audio. Requires an Arabic voice installed on your phone.
Speak your idea in Arabic. The app interrogates it until it is mature, forges a professional English prompt from it, runs it, and gives you the answer in Arabic.
You need at least one key from an AI service. The key stays encrypted on your phone and leaves only for its own service.
Google Gemini — has a free tier with no credit card. Get a key from Google AI Studio.
Claude — from the Anthropic console, API Keys. Paid.
ChatGPT — from the OpenAI dashboard, API keys. Paid.
DeepSeek — from the DeepSeek platform, API keys. Paid, and inexpensive.
Note: Gemini refuses requests from some countries with a "location is not supported" message. If that happens, pick another provider above — the app works with any of them.
Your audio is never saved. Your sessions are stored on this device only, and you can delete them any time from Settings.
The app follows your phone\'s language unless you choose otherwise.
